text:
cheng: heads-up — after the kernelselect tweak merged yesterday, we’re seeing ~2.8x p99 increase on 8-GPU TP jobs when batch_size_per_gpu <= 2. NVLink graph shows one switch link hitting 98% and we fallback to PCIe ring; allreduce stalls.
maria: ouch. which cluster + model? can you paste the perf summary?
cheng: repro on stage-nvmesh-2, model xlarge-llm-1 with TP=2 PP=4. perf snapshot:
```
# summary
median latency: 210ms -> 250ms
p99 latency: 430ms -> 1200ms
allreduce time (per step): 12ms -> 90ms
nvlink util (hotlink): 98% -> saturating
pcie fallback transfers: +3.2x
```
aj: that looks like the kernelselect now prefers the fused-kernel that shuffles KV across devices aggressively. If the topology isn't consulted, it can cause cross-switch hops. Did the change touch the comm-path heuristics?
cheng: yes — kernelselect now chooses the kernel variant with smallest compute time ignoring expected interconnect cost. So we traded compute for comm. Short sequences and small batches amplify it.
jamie: I reproduced locally on a 4xA100 box with NVLink mesh. nvlink stats during run:
```
NVLink 0-1: 94% (rx) 88% (tx)
NVLink 1-2: 12%  (idle)
PCIe transfers: spike during KV prefetch windows
```
aj: suspect KV-cache prefetcher is pulling peers' KV to local device before first token, causing big PCIe/peer transfers when kernel decides to scatter. Can we gate prefetch for batch_size <= 2?
anup: propose three actions:
1) change kernelselect scoring to include a topology_cost term (estimate = bytes_cross_switch / bandwidth_link)
2) make KV prefetch opt-in for small batch sizes or short sequences
3) add a new metric in console: per-route interconnect_mismatch_rate (counts times we fall back from nvlink->pcie)
maria: +1 to all. adding topology cost should stop preferring compute-heavy kernels that pay huge traffic tax.
cheng: quick patch I tested locally — added a simple penalty for cross-switch bytes. results (batch_size=1): p99 430ms -> 480ms (was 1200ms). still slower than ideal but much better.
cheng: repro command & trace flags if folks want to run:
```
RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 RUNTIME_TRACE=topo,kernelselect ./run_inference --model xlarge-llm-1 --tp 2 --pp 4 --bs 1
# capture nvlink counters:
nvlink-monitor --pid $PID --interval 100ms > nvlink.log
```
jamie: ran that — confirms kernel decision change flips transfer pattern. also saw frequent small allreduce skews, maybe due to ring selection mismatch. adding a per-step allreduce histogram helped find stragglers.
anup: for rollout plan: revert the kernelselect tweak for now on dedicated clusters, land topology_cost in kernelselect, and add KV prefetch gating by batch_size threshold. then run A/B across mesh vs non-mesh clusters.
infra-bot: nightly-perf-check job 2475299001 finished: regression alert created (jobs/regressions/2475299001). pinging @eng-runtime on the ticket.
maria: thanks. cheng can you open the PR with the topology_cost and include perf patch notes + microbench script? label it "hotfix: kernelselect topology-aware" and request quick review from @aj and @jamie.
cheng: on it — will attach the perf CSV and nvlink logs. planning to roll to canary tomorrow AM and monitor interconnect_mismatch_rate.
aj: FYI we should also add a small synthetic test to CI that runs TP+PP with batch 1 on nvmesh to catch this earlier.
cheng: agree. adding test now. will update thread with results once canary finishes. :thumbsup:
